wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-the-frozen-quee: Lesson of the Frozen Queen Source Legends pg. 32 Lesson Type Major You gain the Glacial Heart hex, and your familiar learns Wall of Ice.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-calamity: Lesson of Calamity Source Pathfinder #169: Kindled Magic pg. 75 Lesson Type Basic You gain the Stumbling Curse hex, and your familiar learns Ill Omen.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-dreams: Lesson of Dreams Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Basic Dreams can be a window to greater insights. You gain the Veil of Dreams hex, and your familiar learns Sleep.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-the-elements: Lesson of the Elements Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Basic Natural disasters and inclement weather hold more power than the mightiest creature. You gain the Elemental Betrayal hex. Your familiar learns your choice of breathe fire , gust of wind , hydraulic push , or pummeling rubble .
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-life: Lesson of Life Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Basic Life can be shared. You gain the Life Boost hex, and your familiar learns Spirit Link.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-protection: Lesson of Protection Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Basic An ounce of protection is worth a pound of cure. You gain the Blood Ward hex, and your familiar learns Mystic Armor.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-vengeance: Lesson of Vengeance Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Basic Suffer not even the smallest slights. You gain the Needle of Vengeance hex, and your familiar learns Phantom Pain.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-mischief: Lesson of Mischief Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Greater Nothing's wrong with some mischief, now and then. You gain the Deceiver's Cloak hex, and your familiar learns Mad Monkeys.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-shadow: Lesson of Shadow Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Greater A shadow is far from empty—it contains something of the person who casts it. You gain the Malicious Shadow hex, and your familiar learns Chilling Darkness.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-snow: Lesson of Snow Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Greater Emulate snow, for it can snuff out life despite its gentleness. You gain the Personal Blizzard hex, and your familiar learns Wall of Wind.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-death: Lesson of Death Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Major Death is final, yet not as inescapable as it may seem. You gain the Curse of Death hex, and your familiar learns Raise Dead.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-renewal: Lesson of Renewal Source Player Core pg. 185 Lesson Type Major Entropy comes for all, but it can be wound back through effort. You gain the Restorative Moment hex, and your familiar learns Field of Life.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-decay: Lesson of Decay Source Howl of the Wild pg. 62 Lesson Type Greater All living things eventually decay, feeding fungus and insect. You gain the Mycological Malady hex, and your familiar learns Insect Form.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-the-flock: Lesson of the Flock Source Howl of the Wild pg. 62 Lesson Type Greater Power flows when many work as one. You gain the Sheltering Wings hex, and your familiar learns Levitate.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-the-shark: Lesson of the Shark Source Howl of the Wild pg. 62 Lesson Type Greater Learn the ways of this deadly oceanic predator. You gain the Blood in the Water hex, and your familiar learns Feet to Fins.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-memory: Lesson of Memory Source Rival Academies pg. 45 Lesson Type Greater Cobyslarni has untold years of memories, which he’s learned how to shape, recalling information—or obliterating it. You gain the Unravel Knowledge hex, and your familiar learns Hypercognition.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-vows: Lesson of Vows Source Rival Academies pg. 45 Lesson Type Greater Words have power, and those who use them to deceive should be prepared to face the consequences. You gain the Censure Falsehoods hex, and your familiar learns Ring of Truth.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-favors: Lesson of Favors Source Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 159 Lesson Type Greater You gain the Return the Favor hex, and your familiar learns Mind of Menace.
wb:text/lesson/lesson-of-bargains: Lesson of Bargains Source Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 159 Lesson Type Major You gain the Over the Coals hex, and your familiar learns Subconscious Suggestion.
